name: Foil'o Wind Energy - Real-Time Fabric
description: End-to-end Fabric project for Oracle/Kafka wind-turbine telemetry, Real-Time Intelligence, medallion processing and engineering handoff.
workspace_description: Foil'o wind-energy telemetry and Microsoft Fabric engineering workspace.

items.description: Primary event analytics container for turbine telemetry.
KQL database for turbine telemetry, alarms and operational state.
Streaming topology for Oracle/Kafka turbine events into Fabric Real-Time Intelligence.
Operational KQL queries for production, temperatures, vibration and alarms.
Real-time operations dashboard for the Foil'o turbine fleet.
OneLake landing zone for Bronze, Silver and Gold turbine datasets.
Fabric Spark environment for repeatable notebook execution.
Bronze ingestion and durable raw telemetry landing.
Telemetry parsing, quality checks and Silver transformations.
Orchestrates ingestion and notebook processing for the wind project.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.label: Environment
parameters.description: Logical Fabric environment name used by the project manifest.

parameters.name: ingestion_mode
parameters.label: Telemetry ingestion mode
parameters.description: Preferred path from the Oracle edge lab into Fabric. The default keeps Oracle Kafka private and publishes outbound to the Fabric Kafka-compatible Eventstream endpoint.

parameters.name: kafka_bootstrap_servers
parameters.label: Kafka bootstrap servers
parameters.description: Only needed when direct-kafka-source is selected. Leave empty for the default outbound Fabric endpoint design.

parameters.name: kafka_username
parameters.label: Kafka username
parameters.description: Optional SASL username for direct Kafka source mode.

parameters.name: kafka_password
parameters.label: Kafka password
parameters.description: Optional SASL password for direct Kafka source mode. Composer plan responses redact this value.

parameters.name: turbine_id
parameters.label: Primary turbine ID
parameters.description: Default simulated turbine identifier used by the first Foil'o deployment.

parameters.name: capacity_id
parameters.label: Fabric capacity ID
parameters.description: Optional existing capacity assignment target. Capacity mutation remains outside Composer apply in this milestone.

parameters.name: kafka_connection_id
parameters.label: Fabric Kafka connection ID
parameters.description: Required only for direct-kafka-source mode. This is the Fabric connection resource referenced by the ApacheKafka Eventstream source.

parameters.name: kafka_consumer_group
parameters.label: Kafka consumer group
parameters.description: Consumer group used when Fabric reads directly from the Oracle Kafka broker through a registered Fabric connection.

parameters.name: kql_table_name
parameters.label: KQL destination table
parameters.description: Target KQL table name used by the generated Eventhouse destination in eventstream.json.
